tool_input.description: Explore Locale behavior with a scratch program

result:
Only the intended test file (plus the test runner's own transient `_tools/.sources`) was touched — good.

All 38 tests pass against the current implementation: I did not find any behavioral bug in `LocaleUtils`. I covered boundary/error cases for `toLocale(String)` (empty string, too-short input, underscore/dash-prefixed country forms, the Thai/Japanese special cases, malformed casing, trailing underscore), `countriesByLanguage`/`languagesByCountry` (null, malformed codes, caching/immutability), `localeLookupList` (variant/country combinations, null, duplicate-avoidance), `isAvailableLocale`, `isLanguageUndetermined`, `ofCountry`, and `toLocale(Locale)`. Everything matched the documented contract, so there are no failing tests to report as bug evidence.
